presets.question: Is foul-drawing just the free-throw rate?
presets.note: If FTAOE were the raw rate in disguise, these dots would sit on one line. The spread around the trend is what shot locations explain: two players drawing the same free throws can be far apart once you know where they shoot from.

presets.question: Do easy shots make good shooters?
presets.note: Across: how easy his looks were. Up: how much better than that he shot. A flat cloud means taking easy shots says nothing about converting them.

presets.question: Does free-throw touch predict shot-making?
presets.note: FT% is the old proxy for shooting touch. Up is shot-making against the difficulty of the looks, so a rising cloud means the proxy carries over to shots from the floor.

presets.question: Who stays efficient at volume?
presets.note: Top right is the rare corner: players taking a lot of shots and still beating what those shots were worth.

presets.question: What does FG% miss?
presets.note: Players at the same FG% can add very different value: a high percentage on easy looks, with no free throws, is worth less than it reads.

presets.question: Do players draw the free throws their shots predict?
presets.note: The dashed line is drawing exactly what the shot locations predict. Height above it is foul-drawing over expected.
